gates.command: python3 -m ruff check dharma_swarm/foundry/patches.py dharma_swarm/foundry/patches_atomic.py tests/test_foundry_patches.py
gates.name: foundry-atomic-patch-ruff

intent: Harden the existing one-file Foundry unified-diff replay without adding a second patch engine. Resolve the scoped UTF-8 target through held no-follow directory descriptors; bind optional root and preimage identities; write, mode, and fsync one same-directory temporary inode; compare-and-replace only the unchanged target; fsync the parent directory; and support deterministic exact-temp recovery for process crashes. Expose a separate exact replacement fsync primitive so a higher authority layer can distinguish visible bytes from a durably synchronized postimage. This packet owns no Mission Control, effect-authority, TaskBoard, provider, deployment, or production completion semantics.

negative_controls.command:
python3 -c 'from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
from dharma_swarm.foundry.patches import PatchReplayError, apply_unified_diff
root = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
(root / "src").mkdir()
target = root / "src/value.py"
target.write_bytes(b"VALUE = 1\n")
info = target.stat()
diff = "--- a/src/value.py\n+++ b/src/value.py\n@@ -1 +1 @@\n-VALUE = 1\n+VALUE = 2\n"
try:
    apply_unified_diff(root, diff, allowed_paths=("src/value.py",), expected_identity=(info.st_dev, info.st_ino + 1, info.st_ctime_ns))
except PatchReplayError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError("drifted identity was accepted")
assert target.read_bytes() == b"VALUE = 1\n"'
negative_controls.name: foundry-drifted-target-identity-fails-closed

honest_blockers: The primitive provides descriptor-anchored one-file replay and explicit fsync boundaries; it does not claim hostile same-UID filesystem custody or a cross-filesystem transaction.

A caller that receives an exception after rename must treat the target as indeterminate and reclassify exact bytes before retry; an exception is not evidence that the pathname remained at the preimage.
This packet does not mint repository-effect authority or authorize Mission Control completion.
Every stacked PR requires external human approval before merge.
interface_mismatches: A visible rename is not by itself a durable effect; the exact file and parent directory must both be synchronized.
A caller-supplied path string is not target identity; optional device, inode, ctime, and root identity pins supply the compare side of replay.
A deterministic recovery temp is evidence only when its device, inode shape, ownership, mode, link count, length, and bytes all match.
session_entry.rollback: Revert the Foundry atomic replay commit and its packet. Any disposable scratch target already replaced must be reclassified or recreated from its pinned base; Git rollback does not reinterpret filesystem history.
